-Recovers 21 Cost for all allies.
-Cost recovery effect boosted by 1 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases the critical hit chance of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Reduces Cost recovery speed of all enemies for 60 seconds.
-Reduces action speed of all enemies for 60 seconds (affect CPU targets such as enemy monsters).
